mechanism: The stool first-contact placement computation hit45s before producing a placement because it started one LP per triangle. Replace that geometry algorithm with direct ray intersection of the triangle-minus-expanded-body convex Minkowski hull. The earliest witness is independently checked with one original barycentric LP. Subsequent path constraints and audits are unchanged.
initialization: Original two stool standing states, raw scene triangles and same6mm expanded body hull; no old solver point, no extended cap, no parameter retry.
equations: For each triangle T and expanded convex body B, intersect t*d with conv(T-B). Each hull halfspace a*t+b<=0 yields a scalar lower/upper bound. Select smallest nonnegative feasible t; place10mm before it, cap140mm.
success_test: Independent witness-LP equality1e-8 and unchanged full-path audits; failure remains rejected.
